description: Built-in design profiles shown in the simulator, generated by scripts/make-profiles.js. Team-saved profiles live in Netlify Blobs (see netlify/functions/profiles.mts).

profiles.name: Current plan: packed triangle in box frames
profiles.description: What the team is building: 2 drums side by side at the stern and 1 in front on the centerline, each boxed in 1-1/2" PVC. The rear pair sits 4" apart (it tips sideways when touching) and the drums sit 6" forward to float level.

build.name: Current plan: packed triangle in box frames
build.notes: The team's actual build. Edit it in raft-simulation.html (Parts tab), export it, and commit it here. Status: planned | bought | installed. Frame config inferred from purchases (3 double sani tees, 5 sticks): one rail per drum line plus a center spine, 5 beams. Confirm against the mockup.

parts.name: Plastic 55-gallon drum (reconditioned)
parts.notes: Team has 4 drums; one is slightly smaller. Enter each drum's measurements under Configure → Drums → Each drum.

parts.notes: Lowe's 2026-10-03. Pressure-rated Sch 40; same OD as DWV, so it fits the same fittings.
